decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to use cards like Architects of Will and Violent Outburst to cycle through the deck and quickly fill the graveyard. Once enough creatures are in the graveyard, the player can cast Living End to bring all creatures back onto the battlefield from the graveyard. This combo is supported by cards like Street Wraith and Curator of Mysteries, while also having disruptive spells like Force of Negation to protect the combo. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a large number of creatures and quickly close out the game.

This Control deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's strategy while generating value through lands and Planeswalkers. By controlling the board with removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Solitude, as well as locking down your opponent's spells with Teferi, Time Raveler, this deck aims to outvalue and outpace the opponent. With efficient card draw and recursion engines like Wrenn and Six and Eladamri's Call, along with powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines, this deck can quickly take over the game and secure a victory.

The main concept of this Modern Living End deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures to then cast Living End, bringing them all back onto the battlefield. The deck focuses on cycling cards and using cards like Force of Negation to protect the combo. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up the Living End combo for a powerful swing in the late game. By cycling through the deck efficiently and playing disruptive spells, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a sudden surge of creatures.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively with quick and efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Seasoned Pyromancer. The key strategy involves disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief while also removing threats with cards like Terminate and Fatal Push. Feign Death and Undying Malice allow for recursion and value generation, keeping up the pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early on and maintain a strong board presence throughout the game.

The deck focuses on using a combination of disruption spells, counterspells, removal, and card advantage to control the game and protect The One Ring, which acts as a win condition for the deck. It aims to grind down the opponent's resources while maintaining card advantage and control over the battlefield, eventually overpowering them with powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Murktide Regent. The deck also utilizes land cards like Minamo, School at Water's Edge and Fetchlands to ensure consistent mana production and deck thinning.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with strong enter-the-battlefield effects and a high level of synergy to create a powerful toolbox of options. Through the use of cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck is able to efficiently tutor for specific creatures to fit the situation at hand. By combining creature sacrifice abilities with cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Zulaport Cutthroat, the deck is able to generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, Grist, the Hunger Tide provides a versatile threat that can quickly take over the game.

The deck revolves around cycling creatures into the graveyard to set up for a powerful cascade effect, allowing you to cast Living End and return all creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield. By using cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will to fill the graveyard quickly, you can overwhelm your opponent with a sudden board presence. Force of Negation provides protection from disruption, while Curator of Mysteries and Waker of Waves offer additional card draw and filtering. The goal is to combo off and win the game in a single explosive turn.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of powerful planeswalkers, removal spells, and big threats. By utilizing cards like Wrenn and Six and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the board and disrupt opponent's strategies, while ramping up to play powerful cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines. The deck also includes cards like Prismatic Ending and Solitude to deal with any threats that may arise. Overall, the deck seeks to outvalue and outlast opponents through careful resource management and strategic play.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. The deck also utilizes Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six for control and card advantage. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Reprieve helps protect the combo pieces, while cards like Lightning Bolt and Spell Pierce provide additional removal and disruption. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats while maintaining control of the game.

This deck focuses on playing low-cost, efficient spells and creatures to quickly pressure the opponent and maintain control of the game. It includes a mix of powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with a suite of counterspells and removal to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Expressive Iteration helps filter through the deck to find the right cards, while Mishra's Bauble provides additional card advantage. The deck aims to apply pressure early and efficiently while disrupting the opponent's strategy to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on using enchantments to control the game by ramping up mana quickly with cards like Utopia Sprawl and Sanctum Weaver, while also drawing cards with Enchantress's Presence and Sythis, Harvest's Hand. The deck also disrupts the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon and On Thin Ice, and protects itself with cards like Solitary Confinement. The win condition of the deck is often through locking down the opponent's board with enchantments and eventually dropping Emrakul, the Aeons Torn for a game-ending threat.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay utilizing powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to quickly overwhelm the opponent. With a combination of disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Lightning Bolt, along with land destruction from cards like Tear Asunder and Orcish Bowmasters, this deck aims to control the tempo of the game and apply constant pressure. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Boseiju, Who Endures gives the deck additional versatility and resilience against various strategies, making it a formidable force in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, supported by efficient instant and sorcery spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell to control the game and protect its threats. The deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain tempo throughout the game by disrupting the opponent's game plan while quickly closing out the game with powerful threats. The inclusion of card draw and selection spells like Expressive Iteration and Consider helps the deck maintain consistency and find the right cards at the right time to maximize its aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on controlling the board and disrupting opponents with a combination of powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler, Wrenn and Six, and Omnath, Locus of Creation. It uses a mix of removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Fury, as well as enchantments like Leyline Binding to control the pace of the game. The deck also includes threats like Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to close out games quickly. The mana base is tailored to support the deck's diverse color requirements and maximize its efficiency.

The deck focuses on control through removal spells and board wipes, while utilizing powerful artifacts like Karn, the Great Creator and The One Ring. It also aims to disrupt opponent's graveyard strategies with Relic of Progenitus. With Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Cabal Coffers, the deck can generate a lot of mana to play its high-cost cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck also includes utility lands like Castle Locthwain and Field of Ruin to ensure it has the resources needed to outlast opponents in longer games.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by utilizing a combination of hand disruption cards like Thoughtseize and removal spells like Fatal Push. The deck aims to control the board with powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Karn, the Great Creator while generating additional resources with cards like Night's Whisper and Castle Locthwain. With access to powerful lands like Cabal Coffers and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth, the deck can generate a significant amount of mana to cast its high impact spells and overwhelm the opponent.
